style_description: 2D modern animated vector cartoon style with crisp 4.0px solid outlines in #1b1516, vibrant flat color fills with harmonic palette (#1b1516, #2b1d1f, #ffffff, #3b689a, #3a4c5c), subtle geometric shadows, zero sketchy roughness, expressive clean facial features, and electric highlight accents in #2b1d1f.
